title: Incorrect root detection
detail: The function incorrectly identifies the root by comparing the resolved path to its parent. This will fail on filesystems where the root does not have a parent (e.g., some network filesystems or certain mount points).

title: Incorrect condition check
detail: The condition `if not self.disable:` should be `if self.disable:` to correctly handle the disabled state.

title: Unnecessary print call
detail: The `self.console.print()` call should be removed as it is not needed when the progress is disabled.

title: Off-by-one error
detail: The stop value is set without adding 1, which is incorrect for byte ranges. The same applies to lines 359, 368.

title: Incorrect handling of invalid ranges
detail: Returns an empty `ContentRange` instead of `None` for invalid ranges. The same applies to lines 326, 334, 348.

title: Incorrect representation
detail: The representation includes the header value, which may not be suitable for debugging.
